name: Easy Chicken Pasta
desc: Whole-grain penne tossed in one skillet with garlicky chicken, broccoli and seasoned canned tomatoes.

source.title: Easy Chicken Pasta
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (12 oz chicken, 6 oz multigrain penne, 2 cups broccoli, a 14.5 oz can of diced tomatoes with green pepper, celery and onions) and the same four steps; the original publisher is not named on the page.

ingredients.raw: 12 oz boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-size strips
6 oz dried multigrain or whole-grain penne pasta
ingredients.item: dried multigrain or whole-grain penne pasta

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp olive oil or canola oil
1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes with green pepper, celery, and onions, undrained
ingredients.item: diced tomatoes with green pepper, celery, and onions

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp snipped fresh basil or oregano

steps: Cook the pasta in a pot of salted boiling water according to the package directions. Drain.

Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds. Add the broccoli and cook, stirring, 3 minutes more. Remove the broccoli from the skillet.
Add the chicken to the hot skillet and cook, stirring, 3-4 minutes, until no longer pink and 165°F inside.
Return the broccoli to the skillet and add the tomatoes with their juice and the drained pasta. Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Divide among 4 shallow bowls and sprinkle with the basil or oregano and the Parmesan.
